author: Myv
body:
Ok, so my computer decided to blow up this morning whilst I was doing homework, so I'm on my Dad's computer. However, his computer is for business use so he won't let me get Minecraft on it.

So, I'm not gonna on Avicus be for a couple of months, but I will still be regularly on the forums.

N.B I'm getting a new laptop for Christmas, which should give you an indication of how long I'm gonna be off Minecraft.

Happy gaming, and I'll see you online again on Avicus in 2015.

iBiZa
